info.description: Real-time ride-hailing platform API. Conventions: docs/api.md
info.title: RideFlow API

get.summary: Requested, completed, cancelled and expired rides and revenue per hour or day
Security and administrative actions, newest first by default
List drivers, optionally filtered by verification status

post.summary: Reject a pending driver application
Suspend a verified driver and force them offline
Approve a driver so they can go online

get.summary: Ride counts, rates, time to match and revenue for [from, to); drivers by availability now
Search all rides by status, request time, passenger or driver
A ride with its passenger, status history, offers and AI analysis status
Health, outbox backlog, dead letters, AI circuit and WebSocket sessions of this instance
Search users by role, status and name/email text

patch.summary: Suspend or reactivate a passenger or driver account

post.summary: Sign in; returns an access token and sets the refresh-token cookie
Revoke the current session and clear the refresh-token cookie
Rotate the refresh-token cookie and issue a new access token
Create a passenger or driver account
Report the current GPS position (REST fallback for the WebSocket stream)

get.summary: Current driver's profile, verification status and vehicle
Earnings from rides completed in [from, to), bucketed by hour or day
Open ride offers for the current driver

post.summary: Submit licence and vehicle for verification

put.summary: Replace the active vehicle; only while offline

get.summary: Available cars near a point (coarsened and anonymous for passengers)

post.summary: Go offline; any pending offer is released
Go online at the given position
Route, surge and a signed fare quote per vehicle category

get.summary: Address at a point, or 204 if there is none (for example at sea)
Road route between two points (straight-line fallback flagged APPROXIMATE)
Place search, biased towards lat/lng when given; call on submit, not per keystroke
Newest first by default
Trip history: rides booked (passenger) or driven (driver)

post.summary: Book a ride from a fare quote; matching starts asynchronously

get.summary: The caller's ongoing ride, or 204 if none (used to restore state after reload)

post.summary: Accept an open offer (first driver to accept wins)
Arrived at pickup (requires a fresh location inside the pickup geofence)
Passenger cancels; a driver before pickup releases the ride for re-dispatch
Complete the trip; measures distance from the GPS trail and computes the final fare
Start driving to the pickup
Rate the other participant of a completed ride (once per participant)
Decline an open offer
Passenger on board; the trip starts

get.summary: Status history of the ride
Driver position and ETA snapshot; live updates then arrive over WebSocket
Computed observations, plus the AI analysis once it is ready (status PENDING until then)
Questions asked about this trip, oldest first

post.summary: Ask about this trip; answered from the trip's recorded facts only (503 AI_UNAVAILABLE if AI is down)
Run a FAILED, UNAVAILABLE or abandoned analysis again (asynchronously)

get.summary: Current user's profile

put.summary: Change password; signs out all sessions
